title: Look Up and Give Thanks
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king once saw a tall green tree
With fruit on every bough;
But then he said, "I built it all,
So look at me right now!"

[Chorus]
Look up, look up, and give Him thanks
For every gift we see;
The sun, the bread, the arms that hold,
All come from Him to me.

[Verse 2]
He lived out in the fields with beasts
And ate the grass like hay;
At last he lifted up his eyes,
His good mind came that day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Willow's brother's tower fell,
She sat down by his side;
She handed him a block to build,
And kindness was her guide.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Now turn your palms up to the sky
And name three good things too;
Like that old king who looked up high,
Each good thing comes from You.

[Chorus]
mood: Looking-up music. A plain hymn step, four steady beats to the bar, soft felt piano walking in simple chords with a faint organ held underneath. The verses about the proud king stay low and close, and each chorus climbs one step higher in the melody, like a face turning up toward the sky. The last chorus is bright and open, a thank-you said in the middle of the day.
